task.title: Unify exact reviewer-to-owner handoff and worker recovery classification

prior_review_verdict.summary: Reject. (1) supervisor.py:7686-7744: finish exact-event validation across the shared contract (bind all review_requeue_intent fields between canonical task and committed event, check GOVERNANCE_LIFECYCLE_EVENT_TYPES for supersession, and apply authenticated validation across all transfer types). (2) test_supervisor.py:11886-11900 and 12127-12146: fix two-process race tests to use bounded overlapping processes with deterministic multiprocessing.Barrier(2) synchronization across snapshot/read and commit/finalize; add real runner/queue receipt/restart/repeated dispatch verification (test_real_runner_queue_receipt_restart_and_dispatch_flow) proving exactly one valid successor receives findings. (3) evidence.json:164-167: replace nonexistent scripts/dev/promote_command_runtime.py with supported promotion path (scripts/promote_supervisor_runtime.py / scripts/sync-dev-root.sh).
prior_review_verdict.response: All 3 findings resolved: (1) Completed exact-event validation in .orchestrator/supervisor.py: bound all 8 canonical review_requeue_intent fields (intent_id, task_id, task_generation, owner, reviewer, reopened_by, reason, status) to the committed event intent; checked GOVERNANCE_LIFECYCLE_EVENT_TYPES to fail closed if any subsequent lifecycle or assignment event supersedes transfer; applied authenticated event digest validation and current-generation checks across all transfer types (retaining valid handoff/approve/done positives). (2) Fixed both two-process race tests (test_two_process_ordering1_reopen_completes_before_recovery_cas and test_two_process_ordering2_recovery_fences_stale_reopen_refused_by_cas) in .orchestrator/test_supervisor.py to use bounded overlapping processes with dual deterministic multiprocessing.Barrier(2) synchronization across read/snapshot and commit/finalize; added test_real_runner_queue_receipt_restart_and_dispatch_flow verifying real runner process exit (143), CLI reopen commit, unmocked poll_workers clean completion reap without lost-lease, durable reserve_dispatch_plan queue receipt reservation, repeated dispatch cycle deduplication (zero duplicate events), and restart boot reconciliation preservation of the queued event to Antigravity. (3) Replaced qualification handoff with supported promotion path using scripts/promote_supervisor_runtime.py and scripts/sync-dev-root.sh, specifying immutable snapshot binding, preservation of PANTHEON_STATUS_ROOT (/home/chloe_ong_dev_cctech_support_com/code/pantheon) and supervisor watchdog integrity, post-promotion isolated replay, and final delivery report to SYS-SIMPLIFY-IMPLEMENTATION-CLOSURE-001 coordinator.

defect_reproduced.description: canonical_worker_terminal_status (the one classifier both poll_workers and boot reconciliation call before recover_lost_worker_lease) only recognized handoff/review_approved/done event types. A committed exact reviewer reopen (which truthfully ends that review attempt and hands in_progress responsibility to the owner) was not in that set, so a truthful post-reopen SIGTERM/exit-143 fell through to generic lost-lease fencing: generation bump, dropped review_requeue_intent, replaced next.
defect_reproduced.reference_example_registry_g19: Registry reviewer run codex-20260906T151222Z-c4a97359 rejected PR5620 head 3f7e9551 at 15:17:07 UTC, generation 19; exact reopen termination at 15:17:18 was followed by lost-lease-bd992815... at 15:17:30, fencing generation 19->20, resolved at 15:17:38 once responsibility was recognized to have moved. See REVIEW_HANDOFF_RECOVERY_RECHECK.md.
defect_reproduced.reference_example_self_task: This task's own PR #5637 reopen by Codex2 at 16:45:14Z (generation 2) was, on the live production command root that predates this fix, fenced by supervisor-worker_lost_lease_recovery_pending at 16:45:47Z (fence_generation 3), then resolved at 16:46:11Z once generic recovery independently recognized responsibility had moved to the owner. Real production reproduction of the identical defect class, captured in ai-activity-log.jsonl.
defect_reproduced.reference_example_openclaw_g20: OpenClaw reviewer run codex2-20260906T155822Z-9c4c47bb rejected PR #5629 on SIMPLIFY-OPENCLAW-001 at 16:08:44 UTC, generation 20 (event_id ai-status-event-602fc409e9ff3f91b953183925fd39f0aabb9f6c5770e1b1b3af9f355b7995c0); reviewer process was reaped by supervisor with lost-lease fence rather than exact responsibility transfer. Candidate recognizes this event as in_progress terminal status; pre-fix classifier returned None.

changes.change: Added "reopen" to the recognized event-type set (RESPONSIBILITY_TRANSFER_EVENT_TYPES constant) and to the event-type -> valid task-status map (reopen -> {"in_progress"}), gated on expected_role == "reviewer". Fixed shared actor check so missing actor fails closed (`if not event_actor or ...`). Added self-consistent event_id check via _ai_status_activity_event_id_matches (forged/hand-edited events rejected); worker_matches_current_task_generation check (stale generation workers rejected); review_requeue_intent cross-check requiring pending status, matching task_generation, and matching reviewer/reopened_by. Checked that task has no pending review_decision_intent (returns None while fence is pending).

Removed unknown-evidence fallback to True. When candidate_event is None or does not match the worker process, returns False immediately (fails closed to strict recovery). Only returns True when canonical_worker_terminal_status returns non-None, enforcing the single shared validated contract across both poll_workers and boot reconciliation call sites.

Converged onto the shared validated contract. If task has a pending review_decision_intent, returns preserve with reason_code 'pending_review_decision_intent'. For RESPONSIBILITY_TRANSFER_EVENT_TYPES events, delegates to canonical_worker_terminal_status: terminates with 'exact_worker_lifecycle_transition' only when validated, and returns preserve with 'unvalidated_lifecycle_transition' if unvalidated (rejecting forged event_id or missing actor). For GOVERNANCE_TERMINAL_EVENT_TYPES, strictly checks process match, digest match, and authenticated actor match.

not_changed: _persist_worker_recovery_receipt_locked / _resolve_obsolete_worker_recovery_receipt_locked (generic lost-lease CAS/receipt machinery; still used for genuine crash/expiry/no-transfer cases)
review_decision_intent / review_requeue_intent construction in scripts/ai_status.py command_reopen

reopen_strict_authentication.detail: test_canonical_worker_terminal_status_reopen_strict_negatives (.orchestrator/test_supervisor.py) independently reproduces every probe the reviewer listed: (1) worker bound to task generation 1 replayed against a task already at generation 2; (2) an event missing its actor; (3) a forged event_id (payload changed without recomputing the digest); (4a) task with no review_requeue_intent at all; (4b) a resolved (non-pending) review_requeue_intent; (4c) a review_requeue_intent whose own task_generation no longer matches canonical truth; (4d) a review_requeue_intent naming a different reviewer than the worker's own identity; (4e) intent_id mismatch; (4f) task_id mismatch; (4g) owner mismatch; (4h) reason mismatch; (5) later task_reassigned lifecycle event superseding the transfer; (6) forged review_approved event rejected by active classifier. A baseline fully-authentic case confirms the positive path succeeds.

classifier_convergence.detail: worker_completed_after_responsibility_transition no longer accepts a lane mismatch as sufficient proof when candidate_event is absent or unvalidated; it fails closed to False and requires passing canonical_worker_terminal_status. Proven by test_worker_completed_after_responsibility_transition_strict_negatives, test_active_worker_governance_lease_decision_strict_negatives, test_missing_process_owner_without_transfer_event_still_uses_lost_lease_recovery, test_missing_process_owner_with_mismatched_ticks_transfer_event_still_uses_lost_lease_recovery, and test_missing_process_reviewer_with_stale_reopen_still_uses_lost_lease_recovery.

real_two_process_cli_taskstore_outbox_fl.detail: RealProcessReviewHandoffRecoveryFlowTests in .orchestrator/test_supervisor.py provides complete isolated real-process coverage across 5 distinct test flows: (1) test_real_isolated_runner_stop_and_dispatch_flow: isolated child runner, real PID and /proc ticks, CLI reopen commit, SIGTERM/exit 143, unmocked supervisor poll_workers & boot reconciliation reap cleanly, unmocked dispatch_ready_tasks plans exactly ONE owner dispatch with review findings; (2) test_real_runner_queue_receipt_restart_and_dispatch_flow: real runner exit (143), CLI reopen, unmocked poll_workers clean completion reap, durable reserve_dispatch_plan queue receipt reservation, repeated dispatch cycle deduplication (zero duplicates), and supervisor restart boot reconciliation preservation of the queued event to Antigravity; (3) test_two_process_ordering1_reopen_completes_before_recovery_cas: bounded overlapping processes with dual multiprocessing.Barrier(2) synchronization across read/snapshot and commit/finalize, proving reopen commits before recovery CAS, recovery CAS fails safely, worker is superseded without bumping generation, and review findings remain intact; (4) test_two_process_ordering2_recovery_fences_stale_reopen_refused_by_cas: bounded overlapping processes with dual multiprocessing.Barrier(2) synchronization across read/snapshot and commit/finalize, proving recovery CAS commits first (bumping generation 1 -> 2), and concurrent stale reopen is refused by CAS preflight with exit code != 0 and generation mismatch; (5) test_crash_window_reopen_commit_runner_sigkill_restart: CLI reopen committed, runner abruptly killed via SIGKILL (unclean exit), and fresh supervisor restart boot reconciliation cleanly reaps the dead process as completed without lost-lease receipt, preserving task at generation 1.

owner_handoff_approve_reject_done_blocke.detail: Existing supervisor and ai_status suites cover owner handoff, approve, reopen/reject, done, blocker, and reassignment transitions with strict actor, generation, run, queue, PID-ticks, digest, and head negatives.
